title: Example 2-13: Print Pages with Continuation Letter (the c is a continuation indicator)

illustrates.quote: (1) Inclusive print page numbers (including continuation letter), both roman and arabic, are indicated for all transcribed print pages in the volume, e.g., transposed materials, repeated materials, and text. Any continuation letter(s) are included.
